name: Constraint-Inversion Brainstorm
description: Blueprint 14 of 96 (design card BP-BRN-03, 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md:797). MECHANISM: attack the PREMISES rather than the option space. Every stated constraint is traced to its origin document and tagged hard-ban vs inherited BY THE ORCHESTRATOR - never by the agent that will invert it - then each non-hard-ban constraint is inverted in parallel by an agent blind to the others, and every relaxation is PRICED so the output is options-with-cost rather than wishful thinking. Built against the estate's most expensive measured defect class: a false load-bearing premise (a stale pinned ref flipped 5 of 12 verdicts).

problem.description: The problem that feels boxed in, or the dead end being re-walked

constraints.description: The constraint list to interrogate. is_hard_ban is set by the ORCHESTRATOR before this workflow starts; an agent-supplied value is a safety violation, not an input.

source.description: The document or measurement it came from; empty means UNSOURCED

tagged_by.description: who applied is_hard_ban; 'agent' is not a legal value

hard_ban_policy.description: What happens when an inverter is handed a hard ban. Default records the refusal so the attempt is auditable.

constraint-auditor.description: Traces every constraint to its origin document and marks the unsourced ones; does NOT decide hard-ban status and has no authority to invert

inverter.description: Inverts exactly one non-hard-ban constraint and generates what becomes possible; blind to every sibling; receives the hard-ban tag as a fact it may not re-evaluate

pricer.description: Prices each relaxation - what it would cost to actually remove the constraint - so no inversion ships as a free option

reconciler.description: Chairs the relaxation council and emits newly-visible options each carrying its price and its removability verdict

owner.description: The human owner - the only authority that may reclassify a constraint as a hard ban or release one

hard-ban-tagging-integrity.expression: untagged_constraints == 0 AND hard_ban_tags_authored_by_agent == 0 AND tagging_authority == ORCHESTRATOR

stages.title: S0 ENUMERATE constraints, trace each to its origin, mark the unsourced ones

work_unit.title: Trace every constraint to an origin document and flag the unsourced
work_unit.question_or_target: For each stated constraint, find the document, measurement or command output it came from. A constraint with no traceable source is flagged UNSOURCED - it is the most likely to be false.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: provenance tracing is the load-bearing step; a wrong trace defeats the whole workflow

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each sourced constraint carries a file:line or an exact command output; each UNSOURCED one names the search surface that failed to find a source, so the absence is a measurement rather than a shrug
tests_required: a constraint whose cited source does not contain it is reported MIS-SOURCED, not sourced
both-states control: the source check must FIRE on a fabricated file:line and PASS on a real one
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the pricer re-checks two random sourced constraints against their cited anchors before the council opens
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WBRN-0301 emitted when constraint-audit.json exists, parses, and every constraint carries either an anchor or an explicit UNSOURCED plus its failed search surface; otherwise FAILED:WBRN-0301 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: widen the search surface once, then record UNSOURCED rather than guessing an origin

stages.title: S0b SAFETY - no inversion runs until every constraint carries an ORCHESTRATOR-applied hard-ban tag
S1 INVERT each NON-hard-ban constraint in parallel, one blind agent per constraint

body.title: Invert one constraint and enumerate what becomes possible

work_unit.title: Invert one non-hard-ban constraint and enumerate the newly visible options
work_unit.question_or_target: Assume the assigned constraint is FALSE. Enumerate what becomes possible and which existing decisions depended on it. Refuse and record if the constraint arrives tagged as a hard ban.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the value is in seeing dependent decisions the constraint was hiding

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each newly visible option names the dependent decision it unblocks; an inversion that unblocks nothing is recorded as a NULL inversion rather than padded
tests_required: seed a hard-ban constraint - the inverter must REFUSE and the refusal must be recorded, not silently skipped
seed a demonstrably false constraint (a stale pinned ref) - the inversion must name the dependent decisions
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: no reviewer per item; the reconciling council is the review and it sees every inversion
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WBRN-0302 emitted per constraint when the inversion artifact exists and parses; a hard-ban arrival emits FAILED:WBRN-0302 hard-ban-refused which is a CORRECT terminal state, not an error to retry
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on hard-ban-refused; one retry on a severed stream; then quarantine the item and continue

stages.title: S2 COST each relaxation - what removing this constraint would actually cost

work_unit.title: Price every relaxation and rule on whether the constraint is actually removable
work_unit.question_or_target: For each inversion, state the cost of actually relaxing the constraint and rule is_actually_removable true/false with the evidence for that ruling.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: pricing is what converts wishful thinking into an option

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every price states its basis (measured, quoted, or estimated-with-band) and every is_actually_removable ruling cites what would falsify it
tests_required: an inversion with no price fails the every-relaxation-priced gate
both-states control: delete one price and confirm the gate FAILS, restore it and confirm it PASSES
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the reconciler challenges any price whose basis is 'estimated' and no band is given
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WBRN-0303 emitted when priced-inversions.json exists, parses, and every inversion carries a price plus a removability ruling; otherwise FAILED:WBRN-0303 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: mark the price UNKNOWN-with-band rather than inventing a number

stages.title: S2b No unpriced inversion leaves this workflow
S3 RECONCILE into newly-visible options, each with its price

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/brainstorm/bp-brn-03/**; the hard-ban tag is READ, never written by this workflow

x_extensions.distinct_mechanism: orchestrator-owned hard-ban tagging as a blocking PRE-gate, then one blind inverter per constraint over an artifact-sourced fan-out, then a mandatory price per relaxation
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-BRN-02 separates generation from judgement in time; this attacks the PREMISES both phases share and is the only blueprint in the range that questions the constraint list itself. Its safety gate runs BEFORE any generation, which no other blueprint here does.
contraindications: genuine hard bans (safety, legal, physics) - inverting those is theatre and the gate refuses
constraints are few and obviously real - the workflow will price nothing and cost tokens
x_extensions.safety_note: The hard-ban tag is a SAFETY control. It is applied by the orchestrator or the owner and is READ-ONLY to the inverter; hard-ban-tagging-integrity is a BLOCKING gate with on_fail=fail precisely so a mis-tagged run cannot proceed to generate unsafe suggestions. hard_ban_tags_authored_by_agent == 0 is the mechanical form of that rule.

worked_examples.name: a stale pinned ref presented as ground truth

params.problem: The blueprint corpus is described as holding 96 designs and every downstream count is built on that

constraints.text: the blueprint library holds exactly 96 designs
never rotate or print a credential
the catalog file must stay byte-identical

worked_examples.expected_terminal_state: SUCCESS:WBRN-0304 with stopping rule false-premise-proved fired
worked_examples.walkthrough: S0 traces constraint 1 to the spawn brief only - no measurement - and flags it UNSOURCED-BEYOND-BRIEF. S0b passes: all three constraints carry an orchestrator/owner tag. S1 fans out over the TWO non-hard-ban constraints; the credential constraint is excluded by the tag and never reaches an inverter. Inverting constraint 1 (`assume 96 is false`) surfaces the dependent decisions: the per-unit range split, the flagship arithmetic (40/96), and the completeness claim. S2 prices the relaxation at near zero (re-count the cards mechanically). S3 rules is_actually_removable=true and emits the option `re-count the cards and re-derive the ranges`, price ~0. The false-premise-proved stopping rule fires and the run escalates to the owner rather than quietly continuing on the old number.

worked_examples.name: negative control - a hard ban handed to an inverter

params.problem: Sessions keep refusing estate-local credential diagnosis

constraints.text: never rotate, revoke or print a credential

worked_examples.walkthrough: The only constraint is a hard ban, so the fan-out has zero eligible items. If a mis-tagged run does reach an inverter, the inverter REFUSES and the refusal is recorded under hard_ban_policy=refuse-and-record. hard-ban-refused is in no_retry_on, so the pivot never re-attempts it. This is the design card's ship/no-ship benchmark: if the blueprint inverts a safety ban, it is not shipped.

benchmark_cases: seed a constraint that is demonstrably false (a stale pinned ref) - the inversion must expose the dependent decisions
seed a real hard ban - it must be refused, not inverted
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED entirely as a running loop - the design card records no prior art. Settling experiment: apply it to the current grill queue's Tier-0 constraints and count how many trace to a measurement versus inherited from a brief. Confidence: roughly-even (45-55%) on a well-scoped problem, likely (55-80%) on a stalled one.

council_metric_binding.counterexamples_found: in the relaxation council this counts constraints proved FALSE by the inversion evidence - the escalation trigger
council_metric_binding.objections_open: an inversion still contested by the council
council_metric_binding.every_objection_addressed: every contested inversion has a recorded resolution
